slides.title: 5 signs your phone is wrecking your semester

slides.heading: you "study" with _tiktok open_
slides.text:
the chapter took 3 hours

the reading took _20 minutes_

slides.heading: you start the essay _at midnight_
slides.top: it's due at 9. you had _two weeks_
slides.text: and the first hour is still _scrolling_

slides.heading: you miss your 8am _from your bed_
slides.top: awake, phone in hand, _watching the time pass_
slides.text:
you weren't asleep

you just _couldn't get up_

slides.heading: you're _tired in every lecture_
slides.top: running on 5 hours and _an energy drink_
slides.text:
the 2am scroll is a loan

you pay it back _at 10am_

slides.heading: your feed _doesn't know you have finals_
slides.text:
so my apps _go to sleep at bedtime_ now

and in the morning they stay asleep _till i do 10 push-ups_

slides.question: send this to your roommate 👀 who's worse?
